tagline: Build catalog estimates and proposals for My Ops Tracker customers and projects — website builds, Google Business Profile, Yelp, Facebook and social posting.
summary: Estimate & Proposals writes estimates for a fixed catalog of repeatable services: `website_build`, `google_business_profile`, `yelp_reviews`, `facebook_posting` and `social_posting`. Each estimate belongs to a customer and project that live in My Ops Tracker's CRM; this app reads those through the studio gateway and stores only the estimates and their line items.

A draft estimate is an editable set of line items. Once sent, accepted or declined it becomes a read-only proposal with **Print / PDF**, and accepted estimates show a payment panel. A document-payload endpoint flattens an estimate, its line items and CRM data into placeholders for templates and for My Ops Tracker to read.
audience: You run a small agency selling packaged local-business services and send many similar proposals.
Your customers and projects already live in My Ops Tracker.
You run the studio stack: on-device dispatcher (main gateway on port 3010) and my-ops-tracker storage.
notFor: Custom, free-form quotes — only the five catalog kinds; `custom` is out of scope in v1.
Managing customers or projects — those are read from My Ops Tracker.
Invoicing or collecting payment — accepted estimates only show payment details.

capabilities.title: Estimates list
capabilities.detail: `/estimates` lists estimates with status filters; the create modal picks one of the five catalog kinds.

capabilities.title: Estimate detail by status
capabilities.detail: `/estimate-detail-page`: drafts show the line-item table; sent/declined show the read-only proposal with **Print / PDF**; accepted adds a payment panel.

capabilities.title: Customers and projects from the CRM
capabilities.detail: `/customers`, `/projects` and their detail pages read My Ops Tracker data via `GET /api/crm/*`.

capabilities.title: Document payload
capabilities.detail: `GET /api/estimates/:estimateId/document-payload` returns estimate, line items, CRM entities, computed totals and flat placeholders.

capabilities.title: Gateway exposure
capabilities.detail: External automation reaches the API only through the main gateway and the project dispatcher, limited to rows in `dispatcher_exposed_endpoints`.

components.name: Web app
components.owns: All UI. Same-origin Next route handlers proxy to the main gateway (`MAIN_GATEWAY_URL` + `MAIN_GATEWAY_PROJECT_ID` + `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET`), or to Express directly for debugging.
components.doesNotOwn: Data or CRM access of its own.

components.name: API
components.owns: Estimate and line-item routes (`/api/data/*`, `/api/estimates/*`), catalog kind rules, document payload, and the CRM proxy (`/api/crm/*`) to My Ops Tracker storage.
components.doesNotOwn: SQL — it calls the storage server's `invoke` directly or through the gateway.

components.name: Storage server
components.runsOn: The machine with the `estimate_and_proposals` database (env default port 3081)
components.owns: Migrations (`estimates`, `estimate_line_items`, `dispatcher_exposed_endpoints`), all SQL behind `POST /api/storage/v1/invoke`, seed export/import.
components.doesNotOwn: HTTP for browsers or CRM data.

components.name: Project dispatcher
components.owns: Intended to be spawned by the main gateway and proxy only exposed endpoints. Currently a README and setup notes — the implementation still has to be copied in.

dataFlow: The browser calls the web app's own `/api/*` routes.
Next forwards to the main gateway (`http://127.0.0.1:3010/estimate-and-proposals/...`) with the gate secret, which reaches the E&P Express API.
Express reads and writes estimates via storage: **direct** (`ESTIMATE_PROPOSALS_STORAGE_URL` + secret) or **gateway** (`CANONICAL_DATA_ACCESS_MODE=gateway`).
Customer and project reads go Express → main gateway → my-ops-tracker storage (`OPS_TRACKER_GATEWAY_PROJECT_ID`).
My Ops Tracker can read an estimate back through the document-payload endpoint.

trust.title: Browser
trust.detail: No secrets; only `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_TIMEOUT_MS`. The gate secret is added server-side by Next.

trust.title: Web / API servers
trust.detail: Hold `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET` and the storage secret. Never hold `DATABASE_URL`.

trust.title: Storage host
trust.detail: Only place with `DATABASE_URL`; accepts callers with `STORAGE_DISPATCHER_SECRET`.

commonTasks.title: Run on the studio
commonTasks.when: First setup on the machine that owns the data.
steps: On the **Storage Express** repo, **Set up local database** to create `estimate_and_proposals` and apply `migrations/` (005 adds sample estimates; 006–007 expose CRM and data endpoints).
Set `STORAGE_DISPATCHER_SECRET` on storage and the same value as `ESTIMATE_PROPOSALS_STORAGE_SECRET` on the API (**Direct** data plane).
Set `MAIN_GATEWAY_URL`, `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET` and `OPS_TRACKER_GATEWAY_PROJECT_ID=my-ops-tracker` on the API and the gateway vars on the web.

commonTasks.title: Use from a laptop
steps: Pick the **gateway** data plane on the API (`CANONICAL_DATA_ACCESS_MODE=gateway`, `MAIN_GATEWAY_PROJECT_ID=estimate-and-proposals`).
Point `MAIN_GATEWAY_URL` at the studio (`http://<studio-ip>:3010`) on both web and API.

commonTasks.title: Write and send an estimate
commonTasks.when: A customer asks for a quote.
steps: Make sure the customer and project exist in My Ops Tracker.
On `/estimates`, create an estimate, pick the kind, customer and project.
Fill in line items on the draft, then move it to **sent** and use **Print / PDF**.

troubleshooting.fix: The CRM proxy can't reach My Ops Tracker. Check `MAIN_GATEWAY_URL`, `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET` and that my-ops-tracker storage exposes customers (its `004_dispatcher_exposed_endpoints.sql`).

troubleshooting.symptom: Web requests return 401/403 from the gateway
troubleshooting.fix: `DISPATCHER_GATE_SECRET` on the web doesn't match the gateway, or the path isn't listed in `dispatcher_exposed_endpoints` (apply migrations 006–007).
Storage unreachable or secret mismatch. `curl <storage>/api/storage/health` and compare secrets.
By design — only the five catalog kinds exist in v1.

glossary.definition: One of five code-defined catalogs (website build, GBP, Yelp reviews, Facebook posting, social posting).
Flattened estimate + CRM data + placeholders for templates.
The studio on-device dispatcher on port 3010 that routes `/<project-id>/…` to project services.
A row in `dispatcher_exposed_endpoints` allowing the gateway to forward one method + path.

hubNotes: Ports disagree: the registry says storage 3094 / API 3095 / dispatcher 3093, but the `.env.example` files and dispatcher README use 3081 / 3082 / 3085. Make the API's `ESTIMATE_PROPOSALS_STORAGE_URL` match whatever storage actually runs on.
The registry lists `estimate-and-proposals-express-dispatcher-server`, which is cloned locally but isn't a git repo and has no code yet (README only). hub.local.json has no path for it.
Repo READMEs for web, API and storage are still the templates; the ADRs carry the real design.
Depends on the my-ops-tracker project and the on-device dispatcher being up.
